title: SKU/product-based Clanks: the QC vocabulary's fourth terminal action marks the item no longer available
requirement: For a SKU/product-based Clank, the QC decision vocabulary MUST support Useful, Not-useful, and False-positive, plus a fourth terminal decision meaning 'this item is no longer available/in stock as the thing being tracked.' The canonical fleet name for that fourth action is OUT_OF_STOCK; an equivalent semantic encoding (e.g. an availability-change event type plus a reason code) MAY be used instead of a literal fourth enum value, provided it is queryable as a distinct terminal QC outcome.
rationale: Directly evidenced in watch-clank's own EventReview vocabulary (the fleet's gold-standard reference) and matched literally in feature-phone-clank, tablet-clank, and smartwatch-clank. oem-radar implements the same semantics but folds it into change_type=AVAILABILITY_CHANGED plus a TEMPORARY_STOCK_CHANGE reason code rather than a literal fourth top-level action — this is a real, working divergence in encoding, not a gap, which is why the acceptance criteria allow either form rather than mandating one literal string.
forbidden: A SKU-based Clank with no way at all to mark an item terminally unavailable distinct from Not-useful or False-positive
acceptance: USEFUL, NOT_USEFUL, FALSE_POSITIVE, and an availability/out-of-stock terminal outcome are all distinct, queryable QC outcomes
The recently-QC'd view (STD-UI-COM-004) can show which items were marked out-of-stock/unavailable, whichever encoding is used

evidence.summary: Exact same four-value vocabulary including OUT_OF_STOCK, literally matching watch-clank.

Divergent encoding: HIT/INTERESTING/NOISE/BUG plus AVAILABILITY_CHANGED+TEMPORARY_STOCK_CHANGE reason code, explicitly commented as the mapping to the fleet's Useful/Not-useful/False-positive/Out-of-stock vocabulary.

notes: Pass 1 candidate. Recommendation QUALIFIED, not STRONG — the acceptance criteria were deliberately written to accommodate oem-radar's alternate-but-equivalent encoding rather than forcing a rewrite; operator should confirm this framing is acceptable before REVIEWED.
